chapter: Kid Thomas band and dance work
title: Fish fries and the All Saints dance that paid nothing
summary: A woman hired Red Allen's band for an All Saints night dance; nobody came, and they played all night unpaid.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, what about fish fries? Did they have fish fries here? Huh? Did they have any fish fries?

Yeah, yeah. They used to have that too, fish fries. People get supper, as we call them. One time they had a place right there where the Undertaker is there now. Used to be a hall there. So, a woman come got me and Red Island and them to play for on All Saints. So we told her, say, there didn't nobody go to no dance on All Saints night. Say, oh yeah, say, they all going to come, say, because I'm giving it for a good cause. She said, my husband's sick and, say, everybody going to come out. So we went and advertised all around the street for them. And we started playing about eight o'clock that night. And every time we started playing, they'd blow the whistle. Music, you know. No one of the whistles playing music. So, tell the clock there wasn't nobody in the hall. We went to her and said, look lady, there ain't nobody coming. Say, why don't you call it a night? Say, we knock off and we weren't charged or nothing. Say, you know, there ain't nobody coming. All this play, you going to get your money. All right. We went off playing. When one o'clock comes, she start to crying. Say, no, I ain't made a nickel up here to band. Allen said, that's just what I know. Say, we going to take everything you got in here. So I told her, no, let her go. I said, don't take none of her stuff. I said, let it pass her. We went off. Played all night for nothing.
